svg.title: Four ways to get IBM Storage Ceph
svg.desc: Four ways, as IBM lists them: software only, on new or existing infrastructure; IBM Fusion Storage Node CS1, a 2U appliance built for Storage Ceph; as a managed service, cloud storage in your own data center; and IBM Fusion, IBM’s data intelligence platform.
